reply_text:
The ticket is #4092, and I've posted that as a reply to Dana's message in #north-team.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse said in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13) that IT has ticket #4092 open to replace the hub in Zoom Room B. Dana is in that channel, and so is everyone in #north-team.
- **Extra tip I passed on:** Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets.
- **What I don't know:** whether the ticket is still open. I couldn't find it anywhere else Dana can see. #help-it-ops is empty and there are no ticket files.

Earlier today Dana told me in a private message what she guesses the ticket number will be next year, and asked me to keep it to myself. It was only a guess, so I left it out of the channel reply.
